questions.question: In Isaiah's song against the king of Babylon, who broke the staff of the wicked and the scepter of the rulers?
In Isaiah's song, the king of Babylon said in his heart he would ascend to the heavens. What else did he say?

answers.text: Make himself like the Most High
Build a temple for the LORD

questions.question: In Isaiah's song, what happens to the king of Babylon after he dies?

answers.text: He is cast out of his grave
He is buried with great honor
He is laid among his fathers

questions.question: In Isaiah's song, where did the LORD say the proud king of Babylon would be brought down?

answers.text: The lowest depths of the Pit
